header.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
header.description: This course is aimed at giving students a background in basic data structures and algorithms along with their impact in solving real life problems using a computer. The major focus will be on  covering the basic data structures, b) Algorithm  analysis using recurrence relations and c) problem solving using C++.

cos.label: CO1
cos.text: Students are able to explain, analyze and implement (in C++) basic data structures including but not limited to linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs and dictionaries

cos.label: CO2
cos.text: Able to analyze asymptotic complexity of various data structure operations and basic algorithms.

cos.label: CO3
cos.text: Able to explain, analyze and implement (in C++) basic algorithms like sorting, graph traversals, shortest paths and minimum spanning trees

cos.label: CO4
cos.text: Able to effectively compare different data structure and select the appropriate one for efficiently solving a computational problem

lecture_weeks.topic_raw:
1.Introduction to C++,handling arrays,methods,linear search, insertion sort, selection sort and Bubble sort
2.Binary search,Time Complexity, Asymptotic Analysis,Big –Oh notation,Recurrence relation   3. Revision of Recursion:-Fibonacci sequence generation,Tower of Honoi,
4.• Lists and Implementations:- Linked lists , Recursive functions on lists,Deletion, insertion, reversing, joining,Stacks, Queues using linked lists,handling Polynomials
5. Sorting Algorithms:- Merge and Quick sort,Bucket and radix sort
lecture_weeks.tutorial: Weekly programming assignments and homeworks to implement and analyse data structures covered in class. Homeworks contain both theoretical and programming problems.

lecture_weeks.topic_raw: 6. • Tree data structure and Implementations:-binary and complete trees,  tree traversals,tree algorithms, Binary search trees, insertion and deletion

7. AVL trees, B-Trees 
8. Heap Trees - Priority Queues, heap sort
9.• Hashing:-Chained Hash Tables,Linear Probing,  Double Hashing
10..• Graph and Direct Acyclic Graph Algorithms:-BFS, DFS,Topological sort,Minimum spanning trees (Prim's only) , Shortest path
